pattern: にかかっては / にかかったら / にかかると / かかれば
aliases: ni kakatte wa / ni kakattara / ni kakaru to / kakareba
purpose: Show what someone’s skill or handling does to a situation.
keywords: Person + にかかっては / にかかると / にかかったら
In his hands, even a hard problem becomes a game.
In that editor’s hands, even a long piece becomes half its length.
As far as my grandmother is concerned, I am still a child.
formation: Person + にかかっては / にかかると / にかかったら
restrictions: Can praise ability or criticize someone’s treatment.
mistake: Different from にかかっている meaning depend on.
